title: Lesson 85: Never Too Old To Learn

segments.text: How long has Mr. Page been teaching?
segments.translation: 佩奇先生教书教了多久？

segments.text: I have just received a letter from my old school, informing me that my former headmaster, Mr. Stuart Page, will be retiring next week.
segments.translation: 我刚收到母校的一封信，通知我以前的校长斯图尔特·佩奇先生下周将退休。

segments.text: Pupils of the school old and new, will be sending him a present to mark the occasion.
segments.translation: 学校新老学生将送给他一件礼物以纪念这一时刻。

segments.text: All those who have contributed towards the gift will sign their names in a large album which will be sent to the headmaster's home.
segments.translation: 所有为礼物捐款的人都将在一本大相册上签名，相册将被送到校长家。

segments.text: We shall all remember Mr. Page for his patience and understanding and for the kindly encouragement he gave us when we went so unwillingly to school.
segments.translation: 我们都将记住佩奇先生的耐心和理解，以及当我们很不情愿地去上学时他给我们的亲切鼓励。

segments.text: A great many former pupils will be attending a farewell dinner in his honour next Thursday.
segments.translation: 下周四，许多老校友将参加为他举行的告别宴会。

segments.text: It is a curious coincidence that the day before his retirement, Mr. Page will have been teaching for a total of forty years.
segments.translation: 有一个奇特的巧合，在他退休的前一天，佩奇先生正好教了整整40年书。

segments.text: After he has retired he will devote himself to gardening.
segments.translation: 退休后他将致力于园艺。

segments.text: For him, this will be an entirely new hobby.
segments.translation: 对他来说，这将是一个全新的爱好。

segments.text: But this does not matter, for, as he has often remarked, one is never too old to learn.
segments.translation: 但这没关系，因为正如他常说的那样，活到老学到老。
